dogecoin.text:
@susanhillwriter There are online brokers. Or you could use an app that allows you to buy and sell (The other day I spent $50 on Dogecoin, using the EToro Stocks app on my mobile). 
It is digital cash -- a computer file which is stored in a 'digital wallet' app. There is no actual physical coin!

@clewis2015 @HeroDividend I bought a little Dogecoin just before Musk went on SNL. Then sold it 6 weeks later at a loss of about 50%. I couldn't stand having to rely so much on guesswork to predict its trajectory. Despite that, I know that Cryptos definitely have a strong future in digital finance
